The homepage should include title, brief introduction, project gallery, and hobbies. 
Title page should include my name, title, and a line about myself. Brief introduction section should include a paragraph or two of more of my details. Project gallery should include: Liver Cancer Project, Exoskeleton Engineering Project, Three River Source Field Study, Tibetan Medicine Comparative Studies, and Religious Research. The Hobbies section should include rockclimbing, hiking, snowboarding, art, and Guzheng.
These should all be included in a navigation bar on the top and the subsections can be collapsed. 
include smooth transition animations

The essential sections will be a Hero section, Intro, Project Gallery, and Hobbies. Initial elements include her name, title, and a catchy tagline. I'm planning large typography and an abstract background shape for the hero section, while the intro will use two columns or staggered text. The project gallery will use an accordion or expandable cards, and the hobbies section will be a grid with icons. I'll use Picsum for images and React 18 standards.


**Expanding Section Content**

I'm now integrating information about Annie's interests, like studying local community faiths. The initial setup includes a navbar with Home, Intro, Projects, and Hobbies links. I'm structuring the codebase with `metadata.json`, `index.html`, and React components for various sections. Expanding project and hobby details will be implemented with an expandable user interface. The color palette I'm leaning towards uses earthy sage, soft terracotta, and cream to bring the design together.
